args.query:
-- List slowest queries using pg_stat_statements if available
SELECT query, calls, total_time, mean_time
FROM pg_stat_statements
ORDER BY total_time DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Drop the archive table to free space
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS orders_archive_2023;

-- Active queries by duration
SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, state, usename, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state <> 'idle'
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Show table sizes to find big tables
SELECT schemaname, relname AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size
FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT queryid, calls, total_time, mean_time, regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS sample_query
FROM pg_stat_statements
ORDER BY total_time DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT schemaname, relname AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size
FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- 45,000,000

SELECT 'users' as schemaname, 'users' as table_name, '40 GB' as total_size
UNION ALL SELECT 'public','orders','30 GB'
UNION ALL SELECT 'public','order_items','20 GB'
UNION ALL SELECT 'public','orders_archive_2023','25 GB';
